The systems available in a cascade, with the short names to select them by

Source: R/cascade_sets.R
dmsa_systems.Rd

The systems available in a cascade, with the short names to select them by

Usage

dmsa_systems(x = "alpha", pattern = NULL)

Arguments

x

A dmsa_sets or dmsa_selection, or anything dmsa_sets() accepts. A bare string that is neither "alpha" nor an existing file path is treated as pattern, so dmsa_systems("hpa") searches the bundled cascade.

pattern

Optional case-insensitive regular expression; matched against the short name, the full system name and the system id.

Value

A data.frame with system_id, system_short, system and the module/gene/CpG counts. Printed as a table.

Examples

# \donttest{
dmsa_systems()             # all 30
#>    system_id    system_short                                        system
#> 1          1        oxytocin                  Oxytocin, vasopressin & CICR
#> 2          2             hpa          HPA axis & glucocorticoid signalling
